# Sophia Epstein — Journalism Portfolio

> Sophia Epstein is a freelance features writer specialising in technology and business
> strategy. She writes about how innovation, technology, and business intersect — covering
> AI, the future of work, sustainability, and creative entrepreneurship.
>
> Her work has appeared in Wired UK, BBC Worklife, GQ, Contagious, and Weapons of Reason.
> She also produces brand journalism and editorial partnerships for companies including
> Polestar, L'Oréal, SAP, and Salesforce.

## About

Sophia Epstein is a journalist based in the UK. She specialises in long-form features and
reported essays, with a focus on technology, AI, business strategy, and sustainability.
She is particularly interested in ideas that challenge convention or apply academic theory
in unexpected real-world contexts.

## Selected Articles

- "How Do You Control an AI as Powerful as OpenAI's GPT-3?" — Wired UK (2020)
- "Dynamic Data Is the Key to Gaining an AI Accuracy Boost" — Wired UK (2022)
- "Google Staff Squirm as Remote Workers Face Pay Cuts" — Wired UK (2022)
- "The Hidden Age Discrimination Lurking in Your CV" — BBC Worklife (2023)
- "Agriculture Robots: How Farming Is Going Automated" — Wired UK (2015)
- "I Made £8,000 by Sculpting Boobs During Lockdown" — Wired UK (2021)
- "Bloody Risky" — Contagious (2018)
- "The Supply Chain Transparency Illusion" — Weapons of Reason (2019)
